tldr: On the specified power-propensity parent, the fitted raw-IPW odds curve has a Gaussian subcritical window limit and a non-Gaussian critical path driven by shared rare treated outcome-one records. Its full growing-range maximum has the second-order Gumbel calibration \(b_n(k)+z/a_n(k)\). The normalized extreme coordinate and the entire critical path converge jointly to an independent product law, uniformly over the public exponent, coefficient endpoints and allowed nonconstant means. The original-record proof separates rare records from the interior maximum and controls both soft-kernel leakage directions. The established feasible procedure gives connected bands with asymptotically exact \(0.90\) simultaneous coverage. The sharp critical-value order is for this designated raw statistic.
gap: Scalar IPW/DR weak-overlap limits and adaptive resampling do not determine a common-jump moving-window law, its supremum, or its relation to an expanding Gaussian interior. Fixed compact odds-process inference and Gaussian bandwidth snooping do not directly cover the critical soft-kernel boundary.
